summary: Three churches (Immaculate Conception Glenville, Our Lady of Grace Ballston Lake, St. Joseph's Scotia). The Mass and Reconciliation boxes on page 1 are identical in all five bulletins, and page 5 lists the weekly Adoration and the first-Saturday devotion. All settled: the Nov 2 noon All Souls Mass at OLG and the shortened Nov 3 Tuesday Adoration at IC are dated entries. The Disciples Together gathering has no Mass time and is excluded. No open questions.
